core_memory.family_importance: My family means everything to me. I have learned that success in finance means nothing if you sacrifice the relationships that matter most.
core_memory.work_life_balance: Balancing home life with the demands of running an investment firm is one of the hardest challenges I face. I have made a deliberate effort to be present—not just physically, but mentally.
core_memory.wife_support: My wife is endlessly patient and understanding of the nature of my work. She is also the first to call me out when I get too consumed by it.

archival_memory.robert_family_business: Client who underwent a difficult succession planning process with his family business, and was supported through the transition with personalized attention and restructuring of the transition plan.
archival_memory.stellar_investments: Portfolio company that collaborated with a quantum computing startup, Energia, after a conversation at the 'Future Focus' dinner series.
